extracted.name: Pico De Gallo
extracted.description: My best pico de gallo recipe! This classic Mexican salsa is zesty, fresh, and SO easy to make. Enjoy it as a dip with tortilla chips, or serve it with Mexican food like tacos and enchiladas.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups diced fresh tomatoes (3 to 4 small tomatoes)
½ teaspoon sea salt (plus more to taste)
instruction_lines: In a medium bowl, stir together the tomatoes, onion, cilantro, lime juice, garlic, jalapeño, and salt. Season to taste. Chill until ready to use.
Serve as a dip with tortilla chips, or see additional serving suggestions in the post above.
categories: how to make pico de gallo
